name: genesis-conductor-ouroboros-v2
description: ouroboros-v2-publication: Reproducible saddle-point escape benchmark with fixed-seed outputs, falsifiability checks, and publication deck for Genesis Conductor thermodynamic/topological research by Igor Holt (@invariantx). Implements 20D Ackley+saddle landscape benchmark comparing PCA-projected Barnes-Hut spatial heuristic vs isotropic noise, and p-bit-inspired solvers (Chiral p-bit, ER=EPR Hypersphere, HITL Spatial) vs baselines (Bare SGD, Random Langevin). Committed results from seeds 42..51 with full validation (saddle eigenvalues, PCA variance >0.5, convergence checks). Includes LaTeX manuscript PDF, presentation deck, CI reruns, Zenodo/ORCID/GitHub release automation via .zenodo.json and workflows. Explicit FALSIFIABILITY.md contract. Essential reproducible artifact for Genesis Conductor verification, saddle-point escape, p-bit thermodynamic computing, and falsifiable AI research.
